bundle.shortDescription: Continue your Minecraft modpack on any computer
bundle.longDescription: PackSync syncs a Prism Launcher instance — mods, configuration and single-player worlds — between your computers through your own Google Drive. It never merges worlds automatically and keeps every save recoverable.
